title: Remove Transformation section from Home page and add enhanced footer with quick links

requirements.summary: Remove the Transformation section from the Home page so it does not render on the / route.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the Home page (/) does not display the Transformation section content (including the 'Your Transformation' / 'Starts Here' text).
No empty spacing or visual gaps remain where the section previously appeared.
Build passes with no unused-import TypeScript errors (e.g., TransformationSection is not imported if not used).

file_operations.description: Remove the TransformationSection import and remove the <TransformationSection /> render from the Home page composition to ensure the section no longer appears on / and no unused-import errors remain.

requirements.summary: Enhance the shared site footer with company name, short description, and quick links consistent with the cinematic dark luxury theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays the company name "ZIN SHREYA'S ACADEMY".
Footer includes a short descriptive sentence/paragraph in English.
Footer includes quick links that navigate to: /, /about, /courses, /contact.
Footer renders across all pages via the shared layout (not only on the Home page).
Footer is responsive (links remain usable and readable on mobile and desktop).

file_operations.description: Update the Footer layout to include: (1) prominent company name "ZIN SHREYA'S ACADEMY", (2) a short English description, and (3) a responsive quick-links section using internal navigation to /, /about, /courses, /contact; keep styling aligned with the existing dark luxury theme and retain existing year/attribution as appropriate.
Verify the shared layout continues to render the updated <Footer /> across all routes; adjust layout spacing/structure only if needed to keep the footer visually consistent and responsive site-wide.
